title: Fase F-2 (Father) — Drop 7 dead tables + remove dead prompt-runs/templates/hitrates/implementation-patterns/compiler-fields endpoints + sessions.py dead code (templates/hitrates cluster)
design_notes:
Fase F-2 = second dead-cluster removal on Father, following handoff 59 (which removed the prompt-sequences/generated-prompts/project-plans cluster). This handoff removes the templates/hitrates/prompt-runs/implementation-patterns/compiler-fields cluster identified by the rigorous 6-agent reachability audit (2026-07-07).

AUDIT METHOD: reachability (frontend caller? live route? writer reachable? mcp-light/bridge/scripts consumer?), NOT syntactic grep-count. All 7 tables + ~12 endpoints confirmed DEAD: frontend calls only 3 prompt-compiler endpoints (/compile, /dispatch, /assign-handoff-id). No mcp-light/bridge/shell/cronjob consumer. No internal Python caller. Data is seed or old one-off dev-test writes.

THE 7 DEAD TABLES:
1. prompt_runs (11 rows: 1 seed PRUN-2E-0001 + 10 NRUN dev-test writes from 2026-06-12 15-min burst, no live writer produces them).
2. prompt_templates (6 rows, seed: tpl_implementation_small/medium, tpl_validation, tpl_brainstorm, tpl_create_add_local, tpl_update_edit_local).
3. prompt_hitrates (1 row, seed phase 2E).
4. template_model_hitrates (1 row, seed).
5. implementation_patterns (1 row, seed PAT-0001).
6. prompt_compiler_fields (24 rows, seed — canonical compiler form fields).
7. prompt_compiler_field_options (9 rows, seed).

KEY COUPLING: create_prompt_run (POST /api/prompt-runs, prompt_compiler.py:357) is the CENTRAL WRITER for 4 of the tables (prompt_runs, prompt_hitrates, template_model_hitrates, + counter-updates to prompt_templates, + INSERT to implementation_patterns). It is itself uncalled. Removing it cascades to all 4 — which is correct since they're all dead.

COMPILED PROMPT IS SAFE (Human concern addressed): /compile (1112) builds the prompt from REQUEST BODY values (data.get target_project/goal/etc., lines 1199-1206), NOT from prompt_compiler_fields. The table is used ONLY at line 1130/1153 for cosmetic validation-error labels (field_label lookup), with field_key as the default fallback (line 1152). Frontend displays data.prompt in a <pre> (dpmtf-app.js:1346). Dropping prompt_compiler_fields does NOT affect seeing the compiled prompt — only change: validation errors show field_key instead of pretty field_label. Handoff scope includes replacing the field_label lookup with the field_key fallback.

LIVE ENDPOINTS PRESERVED (clean separable): /compile, /dispatch, /assign-handoff-id; /api/ui-labels/{domain} + /api/ui-labels/main (4-layer i18n); /api/workflow/runs (sessions.py:445, reads workflow_runs table — SEPARATE from prompt_runs, frontend calls it at dpmtf-app.js:664). All i18n 4-layer tables, bridge_* tables, UI/Frontend tables = never-drop.

sessions.py DEAD CODE: _compile_prompt_internal (44+, sole reader of prompt_templates) + POST /api/workflow/start (334, uncalled, calls _compile_prompt_internal) + dead read of prompt_compiler_fields at sessions.py:70-76 (fetchall discarded). KEEP /api/workflow/runs (445) and workflow_runs table.

DB BACKUP taken before dispatch: databases/dpmtf.db.pre-handoff60-20260707_132200.bak (851968 bytes, bridge_roles 25/25 + prompt_compiler_fields 24/24 verified).

Handoff 60 dispatched to imple01pay with --id 60 (counter still broken at 48). NOT committed until Human verdict. Verification includes tmux capture-pane injection check (handoff 22 lesson).

Handoff scope includes removing the catalog rows for the dropped endpoints to keep the registry consistent.
